title: Blockworks: Integrations
summary: Connect building patterns to maps, logistics, power runs, and readable base planning.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: HoloMap routes, PowerGrid cabling, Logistics storage, and MultiblockCore footprints all benefit from visible lanes and repeated markers.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Blockworks alongside HoloMap routes, PowerGrid cable lanes, Logistics storage zones, and MultiblockCore footprints so structures remain understandable under pressure.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If map or logistics helpers are missing, build with visible labels, repeated shapes, clear paths, and storage landmarks a player can read without a UI.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
